## File: exemplar-multi-pane-menus.ui-framework.entry.yaml
## Type: ui-framework registry entry
## Purpose: Registry-backed multi-pane menu framework using two side-by-side panes.

id: exemplar-multi-pane-menus
udi: prismata.meta.ui-framework.exemplar-multi-pane-menus
name: exemplar-multi-pane-menus.ui-framework
label: "Exemplar Multi-Pane Menus"
kind: ui-framework
description: "Two side-by-side panes with explicit pane-to-menu bindings and header-driven menu titles."
schema_version: 0.4.3

panes:
  - prismata.meta.pane.lh-pane
  - prismata.meta.pane.rh-pane
menus:
  - prismata.meta.menu.exemplar-primary
  - prismata.meta.menu.exemplar-secondary
pane_bindings:
  - pane: prismata.meta.pane.lh-pane
    menu: prismata.meta.menu.exemplar-primary
  - pane: prismata.meta.pane.rh-pane
    menu: prismata.meta.menu.exemplar-secondary
colour_scheme: default
active_pane: prismata.meta.pane.lh-pane
border_pattern: single-line

meta:
  created_by: copilot
  created_at: 2026-10-02
  schema_version: 0.4.3
